BiblicalUsage: Karkemish is a city on the Euphrates, the place where empires met and broke. Necho of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish, and Josiah went out against him and fell; Isaiah asks whether Calno is as Carchemish; and Jeremiah prophesies against the army of Pharaoh at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar smote.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Carchemish is where the pride of empires was judged: Egypt met Babylon there and lost, and Josiah died there for meddling in a war that was not his — and God was sovereign over them all.
